answer: Complete all 12 unique workouts at the Gatorade Training Facility. That unlocks the Workout Warrior badge, which makes the gym rewards permanent on all new and existing saves.

steps.title: Attend a session
steps.body: A session is four workouts. Each one you attempt raises your Stamina, and the stars you earn convert into MyPOINTS.

steps.title: Aim for an Excellent Session
steps.body: Score 3 or more stars on all 4 workouts and the session counts as Excellent. That permanently grants your next body type and gives you an additional turbo meter for the week.

steps.title: Work through all 12
steps.body: Keep going until every one of the 12 unique workouts has been completed. That is the Workout Warrior unlock, and it makes those rewards permanent across your saves.

facts.detail: Starts at 85. Every workout attempted gives you +2 Stamina.
Each of the 4 workouts in a session is rated out of 4 stars.
Awarded based on the stars gained in a workout.
An Excellent Session gives an additional turbo meter for the week. Workout Warrior makes it permanent.
An Excellent Session permanently grants your next body type. The checklist shows your current type, the next one and how many Excellent Sessions are left to reach it.
Completing the Tennis Ball Toss, which tests your reaction time, earns discounts on Gatorade products.
